questions.prompt: Mpinga mu gitondo. Ariko bariya batazi guhinga sinshaka ko baza.
questions.answer: I hoe in the morning. But those (people) who do not know how to hoe I don't want to come (lit. that they come)

questions.prompt: Nza mw ishuri iteka. Nkunda kwiga ibintu byinshi abantu benshi batazi.
questions.answer: I always come to school. I enjoy learning about many things many people do not know (about)

questions.prompt: Shyira imboga mw isahane nini. Inyama itarimo, ukwiriye kuyishyira mu muriro.
questions.answer: Put the vegetables in the large bowl. The meat which is not in it, you should put in the fire.

questions.prompt: Ntuhora ubikora utyo ni cyo gituma batagushima.
questions.answer: You don't always do it like that; that's why they don't thank/praise you.

questions.prompt: Bafite imfunguzo z'umwigisha.
questions.answer: They have the teacher's keys.

questions.prompt: Uyu muntu udafite icyo kurya aragushaka.
questions.answer: This person who does not have any food is wanting you.

questions.prompt: Ntitumukunda kuko atavuga neza.
questions.answer: We don't like him, because he does not speak well.

questions.prompt: Ntukora neza kuko udafite imbaraga.
questions.answer: You don't work well because you don't have strength.

questions.prompt: Abantu bafite imfunguzo bazashobora kwinjira mu rusengero. Abatazifite ntibazinjiramo.
questions.answer: The people who have the keys will be able to enter into the church. Those who do not have them will not enter.

questions.prompt: Mpora mvuga mu rurimi rwanjye gusa. Sinzi urwawe.
questions.answer: I always speak only in my language. I don't know yours.

questions.prompt: Azavuga yuko atakuzi. Nanjye nzavuga yuko ntamuzi.
questions.answer: She will say that she does not know you. And I shall say that I don't know her.

questions.prompt: Mfite urwandiko rwe rutavuga neza. Sinshaka ko urusoma.
questions.answer: I have his/her letter which does not read (speak) well. I don't want you to read it.

questions.prompt: Impinja zikunda gusinzira cyane. Abantu bakuru ntibasinzira igihe cyose.
questions.answer: Infants like to sleep a lot. Grown-ups don't sleep all the time.

questions.prompt: Urufunguzo rwabo bajya barubika munsi ya ruriya rubaho. Imfunguzo zanjye ndazifite.
questions.answer: They always keep their key under that board. I have my keys.

questions.prompt: Sinshaka guhora nkubwira yuko udakwiriye kujya mu rugo rwabo.
questions.answer: I don't want to be having to tell you constantly that you must not go to their home.

questions.prompt: None ndaruhuka, ariko ejo nzabafasha kuko nshaka kurangiza imirimo yose muri iki cyumweru
questions.answer: I'm resting today, but tomorrow I shall help you/them because I want to finish all the jobs/work this week.

questions.prompt: Akunda kwibuka imigani ya kera no kuyandika kugira ngo twese tuyimenye.
questions.answer: He loves to remember the stories of old and write them down so that we all might know them.

questions.prompt: Ukwiriye kubabwira yuko ntazaza ejo.
questions.answer: You must tell them that I will not come tomorrow.

questions.prompt: Nzi ko ntazabirangiza ni cyo gitumye ndashaka kubitangira.
questions.answer: I know that I will not finish it; that's why I don't want to begin it.

questions.prompt: Sindamushima. N'arangiza ni bwo nzamushima.
questions.answer: I haven't thanked him yet. When he finishes, that's when I'll thank him.

questions.prompt: Ibisambo ntibiragerageza kwiba ibintu bye kuko bitazi yuko atari imuhira.
questions.answer: The thieves have not tried to steal his things because they don't know that he's not home.

questions.prompt: Abantu bose ntibamushaka kuko atazi gukora.
questions.answer: Everyone doesn't want him because he doesn't know how to work.

questions.prompt: Abantu benshi basinzira nijoro, ariko bamwe ni bwo bakora.
questions.answer: Many people sleep at night, but that's when some work.

questions.prompt: Ajya arangiza imirimo ye yose atarataha kuko ari umuntu witonda.
questions.answer: She always finishes all her work before she goes home because she is a careful person.

questions.prompt: Ntibashaka guhora batubwira yuko bazabirangiza ejo.
questions.answer: They don't want to always be telling us that they will finish it tomorrow.

questions.prompt: Bika ibintu byose kuri gahunda nziza kugira ngo abandi babibone ni babishaka.
questions.answer: Put away the things properly so that others can find them when they want them.

questions.prompt: Sindamenya izina rye. Ntibarambwira amazina y'abazaza mw iteraniro.
questions.answer: I don't know his name. They haven't told me yet the names of those who will attend the meeting.

questions.prompt: Sinshobora gukora none kuko ntarasinzira.
questions.answer: I'm unable to work today because I haven't slept yet.
